recipes.title: Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Soft scrambled eggs folded into a juicy tomato sauce.

steps.text: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the salt and beat until no clear egg white is left.
steps.done_cue: The mixture is one even yellow colour with no streaks of white.

terms.meaning: Mix fast with a fork or chopsticks so the whites and yolks blend.

steps.text: Heat the oil in the wok on high heat until it shimmers.
steps.done_cue: A drop of egg sizzles the moment it touches the oil.

terms.meaning: The oil looks wavy and thin, just before it starts to smoke.

steps.text: Pour in the eggs, let them set for a few seconds, then gently push them toward the middle.
steps.done_cue: The eggs are puffed and just set, still a little wet on top.

steps.text: Move the eggs onto a plate.
Add the tomato wedges to the same wok and cook on medium heat, stirring now and then.
steps.done_cue: The tomato skins curl and red juice collects in the bottom of the wok.

steps.text: Add the sugar and the salt for the tomatoes, then stir.
Return the eggs to the wok and fold everything together gently for 30 seconds.
steps.done_cue: The eggs are coated in red sauce and the pieces are still soft.

terms.meaning: Lift and turn the food over itself gently so it does not break up.

steps.text: Scatter the spring onion on top and serve with rice.

tips: Very ripe tomatoes give the most juice.
